steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: That Sinner's an enemy of the Drifter Camp, an enemy of Rustfire, the execs' dog!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: She wants ${PlayerName}! She wants to take away our power!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Stop her! Stop her!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Move! Outta my way!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare!

steps.speaker: Nightmare
steps.content: Roar!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Mmph...!
Hecate has lost count of how many times she's used her power. Her emotions are surging and her mind is in chaos, causing her to lose control.
Every time she uses her power, the shackles ingrained deep in her consciousness stab her soul like a drill, tearing it apart.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Ouch... this hurts so much... Ch-chief... ${PlayerName}... Where are you...

These aren't ${PlayerName}'s shackles. ${PlayerName}'s shackles were always warm and firm. Whenever she felt fear, doubt, or lost control, the shackles would come to her aid, making sure she knew she had someone by her side.
But the other end of these shackles is pure chaos, resembling rage from a crazed abyss, or... the terrible enemy who had torn her Nightmare apart.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You stole Chief's shackles... You touched all of us with Chief's shackles... You took Chief away...

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Look, she's weak! Attack her all at once!

steps.speaker: Rustfire Member
steps.content: Get rid of her!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Where are you, Chief... Get out of my way... You're the ones who took away Chief! Give him back to me! Give him back to me!!!
steps.female_content: ...Where are you, Chief... Get out of my way... You're the ones who took away Chief! Give her back to me! Give her back to me!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare!!
Stop it with the Nightmares. You can't hold out any longer.
A figure appears behind her and knocks her Nightmare into the ground with one punch.
The man dons a Rustfire cloak and is carrying something. Hecate can't see clearly right now, but recognizes his face.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You... You are the exe...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Extreme dreamboat!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: <size=28>Shh, I'm here to help you. Don't give it away.</size>

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I... don't need it! Nightmare! Nightmare!!
Nightmare tries to rush forward, but the man holds down its head as it struggles.
This is the first time that someone has cut off her attack. The sudden interruption makes Hecate lose her momentum. She slumps to the ground, totally drained.
Only then does she realize that she has over-exhausted herself. Nightmare dissolves as she musters all her strength to stand up.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Have a rest, little lady. You really can't keep doing this any longer.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Get out of my way... I don't care what happens to me. Let me find Chief. Chief needs me... That's... my mission!

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Is the mission all that matters? What about your own life? Poor girl...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Then... What about her?
Thud—he drops what he has been carrying on his shoulder in front of Hecate.
It's Hella. This powerful Sinner is riddled with injuries. It'll take her a long, long time to heal. Her pain far outweighs the speed of her recovery.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: When you went on a rampage ignoring everything else, she's the one who stayed behind to hold off your enemies. She doesn't think that your life is worthless.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There's no mission that orders you to protect me, but you still do so because I'm your friend.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There's no such thing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Remember, we're Sinners. We have hearts of our own, and that's what gives us strength. No one can control our hearts.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Once you're able to leave that dark place behind and become the Hecate of your own choosing, you'll be stronger for sure.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Ahh...

She suddenly feels searing pain all over her body. Sapped of energy, she tries to move forward, but not a single cell in her body listens to her commands. Hecate slumps to the ground, almost unable to even talk.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm sorry... I'm sorry... I failed again... I'm sorry...

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Sigh.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Little lady, I still have some other things to do. Please take care of the wounded for me.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Plus, you're still young. No need to keep apologizing. It wasn't a huge mistake. Just say it to your friend when she wakes up.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: This is what you should say to me:
He turns around to face the "Sinners" blocking their path.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: "This is someone I really care about. Please help me. I don't want her to get hurt anymore!"
